params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: oldPosition
params.description: Receives the previous position of the moved column.

params.name: newPosition
params.description: Receives the new position of the moved column.

overloads.semanticRole: Reports, via the two output parameters, the previous and new position of the column the user just moved; intended for use inside the On Column Moved form event.

constraints: Must be called from the On Column Moved form event.
